sources.title: Anthropic: Claude Sonnet 5.5 release (Sep 28)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 on Sep 28, 2026 (day-only; no clock time), second model in Claude 5.5 family, complement to pre-window Opus 5.5 (Sep 22).
claims.context: Anthropic announcement page header + AWS Bedrock model card (launch Sep 28 2026) + full page body read.

claims.text: Nominal price equals Sonnet 5 ($2 input / $10 output / $0.20 cache-read per 1M); vendor states up to 30% less per task via fewer tokens and 30%+ faster output.
claims.context: Vendor price card on announcement page; per-task saving is vendor-measured.

claims.text: Benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 4.0 70.6% (vs Sonnet 5 10.3%), FrontierCode 1.1 Main 46.2% Max, CursorBench 4.0 55.5%, GDPval-AA 1844 (~Opus 5.5 1846), OSWorld 2.1 partial 80.1%, Chartography 61.6%.
claims.context: Vendor-run evals with effort/cost curves; Artificial Analysis ran GDPval/Briefcase on pre-release build with structured-output bug caveat (footnote 3); competitor figures vendor-reported with stale-score footnotes.

claims.text: Context 1M tokens, max output 128K; API claude-sonnet-5-5; AWS Bedrock/Google Cloud/Azure; zero data retention.
Safety: Opus-5.5-class cyber safeguards/fallbacks; biology safeguards same as Sonnet 5; reasoning-extraction classifiers + preserved thinking.
claims.context: Vendor safeguard description; first Sonnet with Opus-class cyber fallbacks.

limitations.text: All benchmark deltas vendor-run; independent reproduction pending.
